title: When a path won't generate
summary: Constraints the robot can't meet, and the starter ones.

steps.title: Solving a path
steps.say: **Generate** finds the fastest trajectory through every waypoint that obeys every constraint, using your robot's real limits. If no such path exists, it fails.

steps.title: The starter constraints
steps.say: Every new path starts with **Stop** at the start and end (the robot sits still there) and a **Keep In Rect** around the field, switched off. They're listed here.

steps.title: Impossible requests
steps.say: Common reasons a path won't solve.

board.code:
Max Velocity of 0.01 m/s over a long stretch  ->  far too slow
Two waypoints on top of each other           ->  no room to turn
A waypoint outside the Keep In Rect          ->  can't be in two places
Waypoints inside the field's walls           ->  no legal route

marks.label: a limit the robot can't usefully meet

steps.title: Fixing it
steps.say: Click a constraint or waypoint in the list to edit its numbers, or switch a constraint off with its checkbox, then **Generate** again.
